title: Cozi Calendar Event Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Baby feeds (`baby:feed`), baby sleep (`baby:sleep`), diaper changes (`diaper:change`), chore completions (`chore:completion`), allowance ledger (`allowance:ledger`), family calendar (`family:calendar`), growth measurements (`growth:measurement`), screen time (`screentime:usage`).
app: Baby-tracking app exports (Huckleberry/Baby Daybook), chore and allowance boards, shared family calendars, screen-time reports, and growth logs via Splunk HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=cozi:event
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(member_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Cozi calendar event events land each day and how many distinct member values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Cozi calendar event records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct member values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It times how much Cozi calendar event activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
